reviews.name: Dan Hornseth
reviews.text: These guys are super easy to work with and very responsive. They made it very easy to get rid of stuff that we’d been holding onto for way too long.  And it was a good value as well.

reviews.name: Bob Gremel
reviews.text:
These guys were great, had a big jug pile of junk in the back yard they took care of it and cleaned it up very nicely.
They have extremely good customer service skills and Give honest answers to questions I asked.
I will use them again, and highly recommend them.
Their pricing was very fair and they were prompt showing up to do the work. Thank you

reviews.name: Cunto House
reviews.text:
Wood’s Waste Junk Removal was amazing to work with! They responded very quickly, and their pricing was extremely affordable. They arrived within just two hours of contacting them and removed all the junk from outside my business.

What impressed me most was that they even cleaned up the area after loading everything. They were professional, efficient, friendly, and went above and beyond my expectations.

I always believe in supporting small local businesses, and I’m so glad I chose Wood’s Waste Junk Removal.

I highly recommend them to anyone looking for fast, reliable, and affordable junk removal services. Thank you for the excellent service!

reviews.name: Brenda Reedy
reviews.text: I picked these guys because I thought hey local guys, I want to give them my business.  Silly me.  I contacted them, they asked for pictures and I sent them pics and asked for an in person quote.  They were going to show up for a quote, I took the day off work and they didn't show up and said they'd come and do the job.  Fast forward to their late arrival to do the job, they arrived late, with a full u haul truck and partially completed my job saying they ran out of room and would come back and pick up the bikes they couldn't get.  I looked and they were paid to pick up the garbage and they missed a whole side of the yard.  They had a coupon and when i asked about it they gave me a story.  I've texted them several times post pickup and see when they were going to pick up the bikes, they keep telling me they will but haven't as of today despite me already paying for that service.  They promised they'd get the backyard cleaned up and then when they showed up to do it, they said they misjudged the amount of work which I said that is why I wanted you to come for a quote so you knew.  The communication has been sketchy and not timely when you inquire, the job was not one I'd say was completed properly for the money i paid them but what do I do they had to have my money to go to the dump and pay to dump the uhaul.  I just wish they would have been better organized and better in providing me what was promised in a timely manner not when you got a truck available.  I will change this review but I feel I've been more than patient with these two to sort of complete the job I paid them for.

reviews.name: melissa colbert
reviews.text: They did a fantastic job with making our time and dates work and were very professional! I will be using them again for junk removal- thank you!
